name: Chat With Youtube
summary: Open-source Chrome extension that summarizes YouTube videos and answers questions about their content.
description: A conversational AI browser extension for YouTube: it reads a video's transcript and metadata so you can summarize it, ask questions about its content or search for specific parts. The landing page demonstrates it on sample TED talks and links to the extension.
contains: search for specific parts of a video
interactive demo with sample videos on the landing page
